Fractal background shader source by Yohei Nishitsuji.
Original post: https://x.com/YoheiNishitsuji/status/2111673230113272074
Author profile states: "My code shared @x is MIT Licensed" (observed 2026-10-18).
The GLSL expression in fractal.mjs is adapted from that post. Initialization,
a radius guard at the singularity, and a standard HSV helper were added for WebGL2.
A final teal/copper/chrome color grade changes only the displayed palette.
